topic: The Clever Chintu and The Raindrop Race
title_hi: चिंटू और मिट्ठू की बारिश वाली दौड़
description: Watch Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot in a super fast raindrop race! Perfect fun for toddlers and preschoolers. #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Teaches competitive spirit, counting, and nature observation through cheerful interaction.

scenes.text: अरे! ये बारिश की बूंदें कहाँ दौड़ रही हैं?!
scenes.image_prompt: Close up, 3D animated orange elephant Chintu with blue scarf looking amazed at rain falling on a vibrant green leaf, sunny garden background, 9:16 vertical, high quality.

scenes.text: Look! Mithu is ready, one.. two.. three!
scenes.image_prompt: Cute green parrot Mithu with a red cap perched on a branch, flapping wings excitedly, raindrops falling around, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: टप-टप-टप! देखो, कौन सी बूंद सबसे तेज़ है?
scenes.image_prompt: Animated raindrops racing down a bright window pane, Chintu pointing his trunk at them, expressive joyful face, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Zoom! Chintu is running, go go go!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu the elephant running happily in a garden splashing in small puddles, colorful flowers, vibrant lighting, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: हॉप-हॉप-हॉप! मिट्ठू हवा में उड़ गया!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the parrot flying through the rain drops in the sky, motion blur effect, bright cheerful colors, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Splash! Raindrop race is so much fun!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu high-fiving near a big puddle, water splashing, happy expressions, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: हा हा हा! हम दोनों जीत गए!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu laughing together, big smiles, sunny rainbow appearing in the background, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: रुको! एक और जादुई दौड़ बाकी है!
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Chintu looking directly at the camera with a playful wink, finger on nose, blurred background, 9:16 vertical.
